{{Quote|Sith holocron verified, master training sequence initiated.|J77|<ref name="cwa">{{TCWA|Battle of Umbara}}</ref>}}
These '''training droids''' were present at the [[Sith Academy (Umbara)|Sith Academy]] on [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. These four droids were designated J77, A79, S81 and T87. They had were similar to [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]], with the head of an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] and armed with [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaffs]] similar to those of the MagnaGuards. Each of these [[Droid/Legends|droids]] stated different parts of the [[Code of the Sith/Legends|Sith Code]] and were all destroyed by a lone [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
